name: Nordic

identity.oneLiner: Scandinavian Modern: bold botanical silhouettes, tactile matte color and functional simplicity.
identity.summary: Nordic modernism balances useful, quiet geometry with large hand-cut botanical forms and confident printed colors. Botanical Pop foregrounds graphic nature; Minimal and Folk tune the same functional language.
identity.authenticityNotes: Never use generic floral wallpaper or circular flower halos. Keep saturated yellow and pink as accents rather than low-contrast body text. Avoid Googie starbursts and heavy offset shadows.

axes.shape: Rounded rectangles with selective asymmetric organic corners
axes.edge: Fine dark outlines, no heavy outlines everywhere
axes.surface: Matte paper and saturated spot inks
axes.ornament: Oversized cut-paper leaves and petals, sparse on surfaces

bands.description: Functional typography and geometry; no decorative illustration.
Recognizable geometry and one restrained graphic rule.
Full graphic program on focal surfaces, not on every control. Default when absent.
